initial_template: Create an original production-ready GAME RUN-CYCLE SPRITE ATLAS on real TRANSPARENT background. Use the attached two existing sprite samples as identity and brushwork reference only. Match its handsome small upright bipedal golden retriever, round expressive dark eyes, floppy soft gold ears, cream muzzle, feathery tail, boots, slightly oversized head and picture-book hand-inked watercolor finish. Elevated action RPG camera facing the front of the small dog by only ten degrees, NOT a side or 3/4 view. LANDSCAPE sheet in EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows (8 entire, cleanly separated full bodies, no other objects, labels, grid, scenery, dust, cast shadows or effects). Uniform scale and centered in each invisible tile, enough margin between cells so staff, arrows and ears never touch another figure or frame. Upper row ONLY straight FRONT view: running toward camera, face/chest visible, two eyes with nose centered between them. Lower row ONLY straight REAR view: running away from camera; only back of head, both ears, cloak back and tail, zero faces, noses or eyes. Each row is a four-drawing natural alternating jog loop in the following order, readable as silhouettes: (1) LEFT boot reaches forward toward the travel direction, right leg kicks back, left arm back; (2) left boot under body supporting weight, right knee raised to pass, bent elbows, head and ears dip slightly; (3) RIGHT boot reaches forward while LEFT kicks back, right arm back, opposite of drawing one; (4) right boot under weight, left knee raised to pass, up/rebound, ears and cape follow through. Do not draw four identical feet or depict four continuous hops. Same character height, body center and cadence across all columns, strongest difference in how the two legs overlap and which boot/sole appears closer. Keep ink undersides around ears, legs, costume, and weapon, retain a little open transparent gap between ankles. Put every paw, tail tuft and weapon tip inside its cell. Charm and readable high-contrast forms at mobile sprite size. No contact sheet of concepts: eight finished production sprites only. Character details:
second_template:
Paint FOUR NEW, very specific in-between keyframes for the attached golden retriever game character (reference already contains a repeated left-foot reach, DO NOT duplicate that stance). Keep the existing clothing, proportions, smile, palette, stroke, and weapon hand. Generate a SQUARE isolated TRANSPARENT sheet, exactly TWO columns by TWO rows, four whole non-overlapping dogs with ample empty space, no text, no halo or shadow. Top two looking STRAIGHT TOWARD viewer, lower two running STRAIGHT AWAY with back of head and absolutely no facial features. These four drawings are deliberately specified as four visually different silhouettes:
TOP LEFT: exaggerated OPPOSITE-foot contact: the boot on the VIEWER'S LEFT extends DOWN and FORWARD toward the camera, with its toe visibly nearer/lower and its big oval sole clearly visible in the lower LEFT quarter of the cell; the boot on the VIEWER'S RIGHT is trailing and raised, small, high and behind the left contact boot. Left ear dips, elbows counter-swing. Big readable open V between the boots. The lower, larger boot absolutely must appear at image LEFT (unlike contact stance in reference).
TOP RIGHT: low COMPRESSION/passing pose, not long stride. Hero body drops on supporting boot on VIEWER RIGHT beneath right hip. Its foot lands flat with angled toe and ankle flexed. VIEWER LEFT boot is lifting forward with knee bent and toe tucked under body. Keep visible air between both boots. Tilt shoulders and excited ears to the OTHER side; weapon follows its existing hand with a small pendulum swing.
BOTTOM LEFT: rear view OPPOSITE contact. Left of screen boot extends out with heel/sole facing camera visibly to screen LEFT; right of screen boot is smaller/higher upfield. Both boots and leg bend visible below the flying cape. Tail follows the tilted pelvis.
BOTTOM RIGHT: rear view passing/compression. Right of screen boot planted under right hip, heel down, toes obscured. Left of screen boot lifted with knee bent far back, with distinct boot sole. Compress about 8% and bend knees. Cloak and tail swing the other way. 
Natural dog-headed biped knight movement, no foreshortened arms replacing feet. Do not pivot bodies left/right; the variation must be articulated running movement. Each figure the same nominal scale. Lit painted dog ears, warm brown boots, costume edge ink and authentic watercolor story-book sprites at tiny game scale. NO additional props. Attached full atlas is the look-and-costume master, not a layout to copy. Exactly four on transparent. Equipment:

equipment.knight: A golden retriever sword knight with a small warm steel breastplate, golden sun and brass clasps, navy blue cape, brown boots. Holds the same elegantly short SILVER SWORD WITH GOLD HILT in anatomical RIGHT hand (VIEWER LEFT on front, VIEWER RIGHT at back), while left hand is empty. The blue cloak and muzzle differentiate the straight front/rear.
equipment.mage: A golden retriever spellcaster. Dark desaturated teal hooded traveling robe edged with antique gold, the hood DOWN around neck, long divided gold-patterned hem, no hat. Holds a SINGLE SHORT WOODEN WAND, crooked with small honey-amber inset gem. Keep wand in anatomical RIGHT hand (VIEWER LEFT on front, VIEWER RIGHT on back) with left hand free or touching same wand. Amber glow only inside the small stone; no cast spell. Back teal mantle outlined with gold.
equipment.archer: A golden retriever archer. Muted olive leaf ranger cloak over warm tan quilted vest with cream sleeves, brown belt, leather boots. Wooden recurved BOW always in anatomical LEFT hand (VIEWER RIGHT on front, VIEWER LEFT on back). A strapped leather quiver of pale-feathered arrows is visibly carried on back above anatomical right shoulder (viewer LEFT on front, RIGHT on back); do not draw firing pose. No sword.

opposite_rear_contact: Paint exactly TWO isolated, fully visible and equally sized game sprites side by side on a wide transparent canvas. Both characters directly show their BACK with the back of head, trailing cloak and tail but no eyes. LEFT HALF of sheet is the teal-robed golden retriever mage shown in reference #1; keep the wooden amber-tipped spellcasting wand in the hand on image RIGHT of its body. RIGHT HALF of sheet is the olive green ranger from reference #2; keep slim recurved BOW on image LEFT of its body and the pale-feather arrow quiver on its RIGHT shoulder. Both have the same single new MISSING running-away key pose. The foot on the RIGHT HAND SIDE OF THE IMAGE extends out behind the camera-facing dog's lower-right hip, the boot near us, BELOW its opposite boot; show its dark oval sole facing us, low on the RIGHT. The foot on image LEFT is much higher, smaller, lifted under the left thigh as though touching ground much farther away. There is a clear wedge of transparent background BETWEEN the two lower legs; the larger right boot is so low and far to the RIGHT that it almost hangs past the right-hand buttock. Legs visibly alternate with attached rear reference pose where the LOW foot is on image LEFT: swap the LEG positions in these new paintings while preserving the locations of the wand, bow and quiver in the same hands as the reference. Soft gold floppy ears, back of head from behind (do not turn), beautiful moving tails, small warm brown boots, child-friendly storybook ink and watercolor, fine dark outlines, twenty-degree elevated action-RPG view, matching the provided art master. No numbered cell, no text, no other drawing, no duplicated legs or shoes, no ground or shadows, the full two dogs separated by a wide transparent gap. Both run AWAY. EXACTLY TWO full figures. Use reference 1 for MAGE; reference 2 for ARCHER.
